page.notes: Long s throughout normalised to s (e.g. "mensura", "post", "sed", "ipsi"), as the rule requires. Hyphens at line ends kept as printed. The first word of the note is in italic; the note is printed in two lines, joined here as "Scilicet con-fiderati." The mark "*" before "simpliciter" is printed as an asterisk and is treated as a reference mark. Doubtful readings: "consumment" (the printed letters are unclear), "deseritur" (the letter after d is unclear, read as long s with a possible f), and "auctì" read as "aucti" with a ct ligature. "quem-admodum" keeps the printed line-end hyphen. The line-end "fi-nè" has an accent on e as printed.
